title: helcia brevis
intro: Helcia brevis, commonly known as the 'Mexican feather grass', is a species of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. The health benefits of Helcia brevis include its ability to act as a natural air purifier, removing pollutants and toxins from the air, as well as its potential to aid in stress relief and anxiety reduction. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe irritated skin and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents present in Helcia brevis include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
